input.manifest_yaml:
"service": "tasks-core"
"components":
  - "id": "catalog"
    "type": "component"
    "platform": "aws-lambda"
    "config":
      "runtime": "nodejs20.x"
      "handler": "index.handler"
      "memorySize": 128
      "timeout": 3
  - "id": "export"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-opensearch"
    "config":
      "engineVersion": "OpenSearch_2.11"
      "instanceType": "r6g.large.search"
      "instanceCount": 2
      "ebsEnabled": true
      "volumeSize": 100
      "encryptionAtRest": true
      "nodeToNodeEncryption": true
      "enforceHTTPS": true
      "publicAccess": false
  - "id": "ledger"
    "type": "platform"
    "platform": "aws-opensearch"
    "config":
      "engineVersion": "OpenSearch_2.11"
      "instanceType": "r6g.large.search"
      "instanceCount": 2
      "ebsEnabled": true
      "volumeSize": 100
      "encryptionAtRest": true
      "nodeToNodeEncryption": true
      "enforceHTTPS": true
      "publicAccess": false
"bindings":
  - "source": "catalog"
    "target": "export"
    "type": "bindsTo"
    "config":
      "resourceType": "domain"
      "accessLevel": "write"
      "network":
        "port": 443
        "protocol": "tcp"
      "configKeys":
        - "key": "OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT"
          "valueSource":
            "type": "reference"
            "nodeRef": "export"
            "field": "endpoint"
  - "source": "catalog"
    "target": "ledger"
    "type": "bindsTo"
    "config":
      "resourceType": "domain"
      "accessLevel": "read"
      "network":
        "port": 443
        "protocol": "tcp"
      "configKeys":
        - "key": "OPENSEARCH_ENDPOINT"
          "valueSource":
            "type": "reference"
            "nodeRef": "ledger"
            "field": "endpoint"
"policyPack": "Baseline"
